separation: Unmodified complete author build_model/extract_speaker, exact matching state tensors, strict load, FP32/eval, matching embedded ECAPA encoder. Both mixture/enrollment separately peak-normalized as official CLI. Every predicted active person with automatically chosen same-meeting solo anchor is extracted. No reference/name/count or output-track deletion.
asr: Same pinned native1.7B/BF16/eager/greedy512/Chinese/no-context and bounded raw-preserving recovery. Every extracted lane is transcribed; exact-zero pipeline guard only. Source mixture full-ASR cache retained, not re-recognized.
scoring: Replace only selected original30s root text in the existing complete per-person Document, leave all other full-meeting text unchanged, then score against the entire original reference. All duplicate/missing/incorrect lanes count. Report global cpCER and independently fixed full-speaker DER mapping/unknown-unmatched diagnostic; no per-clip oracle mapping or boundary-word discard. Categories use full reference utterances, not a claimed pure overlap-word score.
retainRule: Require fewer whole-L fixed-mapping/unknown-unmatched content edits than the frozen baseline, no worse full-S ordinary control edits, and no new complete-execution failure. Otherwise retain raw outputs and reject scaling this exact candidate; no threshold/window/enrollment sweep. Improvements are development component evidence, never full<5%, final holdout or sale acceptance.
singleSpeakerProtection: Ordinary production route retains source recording; forced extraction is an explicit damage control, not silently applied by default.
preparationFailure: Original model attempt stopped on missing torchaudio before weights or any inference. Pinned unmodified official Python frontend added only to separation-worker path; standard PCM wave I/O and native Torch are unchanged. No model/audio/retention/scoring setting changed.
fullRoute: Every predicted-overlap root, all predicted-active enrolled people, same native encoder top1 self-identity check against all6 frozen automatic anchors. All rejected raw lanes retained; no hard time-activity masking. If no lane admitted in a root, retain its full original transcript. Other roots retain original whole output. Same thresholds/model/ASR as routed component, no per-root winner selection.
fullRetentionRule: Report full-L fixed global DER mapping/unknown-unmatched and standard cpCER, all-person errors, short utterance and overlap-context categories separately. Any total regression rejects this whole candidate, no per-root model cherry-picking. Ordinary source route stays byte-identical. Short-person regression and absent/unregistered speakers remain explicit even if total improves; no formal5% or sale pass from this one development meeting.

activity: DIAGNOSTIC only: complete official reference speech intervals and identity alias. No words provided to GSS or ASR. Compare with automatic journal after all fixed outputs; never include this score in the product acceptance result.
ordinary: First predicted single-ID >=25s root in each new meeting; ordinary rawdual bypass is byte-identical to mono. No alternative ordinary window if reference audit contradicts the prediction.
recognition: Exact prior native1.7B inference AST, same512tokens/BF16/greedy/Chinese/no-context/bounded recovery. All raw generations retained; no filler, duplication or reference-word filtering.
primaryComparison: Raw paired0/1 fixedGSS versus original0 with identical predicted activity gates. No oracle count/turn/text/slot choice, no parameter or codec sweep. Full per-mic DER and short-span recall reported separately; mic0 always guides separation regardless of reference score.
retention: One causal control on all four existing complex roots, both mono and rawdual. No new window, model, parameter, per-person winner or replacement of failed automatic results. Ordinary bypass already validated and unchanged; do not rerun it.
scope: Local pipeline feasibility, not fullCER<5%, pure-overlapCER, current-card dual-mic performance, Android deployment or sale qualification.
